slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Keep production behind CI/CD
slides.subtitle: Coding agents can help, but they should not hold production keys.

slides.title: Experiment safely
slides.body: For toy apps, agents are useful for learning deployment commands and platform setup.

slides.title: Limit access
slides.body: For production, keep credentials away from coding agents. If they cannot reach production, they cannot change it.

slides.title: Use a controlled path
slides.body: Deploy automatically to dev, run tests, inspect the result, then manually promote to production.

slides.title: Do not paste secrets
slides.body: Secrets in chat can end up in transcripts or telemetry. Pass production tokens through CI/CD secrets.
